scope: Training-only diagnostic of the existing frozen Mac embedding ensemble on all 108 original US synthesis clips; no model fitting or acceptance
pcm_policy: Preserve original serialized integer PCM exactly; only prepend/append the declared zeros. No resampling, gain, augmentation, trimming or playback.
outputs: Retain all 108 embeddings, member scores, exact equal-mean scores, times, event offsets, source/rendered PCM identities and aggregate voice/phrase counts, including failures.
decision: This probes whether an existing different representation generalizes to the new training cohort. It does not change v46, select a threshold, train another model, certify pronunciation, access unused development/final data or promote firmware. Any fitting follow-up requires its own evidence-based plan.
limitations: These are training-only synthetic clips, not independent human or acceptance observations.
The three presets share Piper ancestry and do not establish independent physical speakers.
Full generated-container ends are process references, not acoustic phoneme boundaries.
This 80 ms embedding ensemble and GPU 10 ms MicroFrontend detector have different frontends, training and event policies; no controlled architecture-only comparison is implied.
No board, microphone, speaker, firmware or audio-producer access. Dining-room production board excluded.
